unit: US dollars per million tokens, standard rates, no caching or batch discount

claude-haiku-5-5.note: rate for prompts up to 100,000 tokens; every prompt here is shorter

electricity.note: Local models that had one GPU to themselves are costed as electricity only: the GPU at its power limit for the whole request time. This is an upper bound on the GPU's draw (the contributor reports under 350 W sustained). The rest of the machine, idle time and the hardware are not counted. The rate is an example; scale by your own.
